title: FHR
description: FAIR Header Reference genome Schema for Genome Assemblies

schemaVersion.description: Version of the FHR schema contract, as "MAJOR.MINOR"; 2.0 from v0.4 (docs/SCHEMA-VERSIONS.md)

genomeSynonym.description: Other common names of the genome

taxon.description: Species name and URL of the species information at identifiers.org

items.description: Author of the FHR Instance (Person or Org)

nameType.description: Whether the author is a person (Personal) or an organization (Organizational), as DataCite nameType

items.description: Assembler of the Genome (Person or Org)

nameType.description: Whether the author is a person (Personal) or an organization (Organizational), as DataCite nameType

dateCreated.description: Date the genome assembly was created

instrument.description: Physical tools and instruments used in the creation of the genome assembly

scholarlyArticle.description: DOI (without a resolver prefix) of the scholarly article where the genome was published, e.g. 10.5281/zenodo.6762550

identifier.description: Identifiers of the genome as prefix:accession (CURIE-like)

reuseConditions.description: license and reuse conditions for the use of the Genome

masking.description: masking applied to the genome assembly

vitalStats.description: general statistics about the genome assembly; N50, N90, L50 and L90 are contig statistics, the scaffold* fields are scaffold statistics

L50.description: Contig L50: the smallest number of contigs whose lengths sum to at least 50 percent of the assembly length.

N50.description: Contig N50: contig length in base pairs at 50 percent of the assembly length.

L90.description: Contig L90: the smallest number of contigs whose lengths sum to at least 90 percent of the assembly length.

totalBasePairs.description: total base pairs of the genome assembly

numberContigs.description: number of contigs of the genome assembly

numberScaffolds.description: number of scaffolds of the genome assembly

readTechnology.description: read technology of the genome assembly (short, long, hifi, etc...)

N90.description: Contig length in base pairs at 90 percent of the assembly length.

scaffoldN50.description: Scaffold N50: scaffold length in base pairs at 50 percent of the assembly length.

scaffoldN90.description: Scaffold N90: scaffold length in base pairs at 90 percent of the assembly length.

scaffoldL50.description: Scaffold L50: the smallest number of scaffolds whose lengths sum to at least 50 percent of the assembly length.

scaffoldL90.description: Scaffold L90: the smallest number of scaffolds whose lengths sum to at least 90 percent of the assembly length.

gcContent.description: GC content as a percentage (0 to 100), not a fraction: write 42.0 for 42 percent; 0.42 means 0.42 percent.

assemblySoftware.description: Assembly software provenance; a legacy name string is also accepted.

assemblyProtocol.description: URI of the assembly protocol or workflow documentation.

seqcol_id.description: Unprefixed GA4GH refget sequence collection top-level digest (sha512t24u); supplied by the user, not calculated by FHR.

sha2.description: sha2-512/256 checksum value: standard padded base64 of the 32-byte digest (43 characters, then =)
